items.quote: Our objection handling process, it's clarify, discuss, diffuse.
items.statement: Our objection handling process is clarify, discuss, diffuse.

items.quote: We are not getting into objection handling mode, pitching features and benefits, trying to convince the client that whatever he's saying is wrong...
items.statement: We should not get into objection handling mode by trying to convince the client they are wrong.

items.quote: What we feel, like we don't want to do it.
items.statement: Clients will resist when they feel they are being persuaded to do something.

overview: This source chunk contains advice on objection handling in sales, particularly highlighting an approach that avoids confrontation and focuses on understanding client objections.
